name: TC-907: Lima — the choices and the note on an item inside a deal (a paid size, a nested free sauce under it, a free dip, special instructions) are sent in the /quote and stored on the paid order — the deal upcharge is unchanged
description: Wings + soup @ $12. In the Lima deal builder the wings are customised: Size '20 PC' (+$4.99), 'Buffalo' in the nested Wing Sauce group 20 PC opens, the free 'Ranch Dip', and a note in the item sheet's Special Instructions box. The checkout's /quote body must carry orderDeals[0].items[<wings>].selectedModifiers with all three modifierIds (Buffalo with parentModifierId = 20 PC) and specialInstructions = the note; the server prices the deal at upcharge 4.99 / lineTotal 16.99 (unchanged). Paid with the Stripe test card, the owner read (GET /api/order/:id) must show orderDealItems[<wings>] naming all three choices and carrying the note. Fails on QA until the template-lima + backend deal-item fixes deploy.

Fill "extra crispy please e69b1c11" getByRole('dialog').getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Special Instructions' })
